$comment: The email area's grants (spec 01 §6.10; ARCHITECTURE §9.4). The outbox is in email_private, which only the worker and email.enqueue()'s owner may use, so no other login can name or lock it. Rows reach the outbox only through email.enqueue(), which runs as fin_email_enqueue (NOLOGIN): INSERT on the outbox and SELECT on the template grants, nothing more. Only the worker claims, updates and deletes rows. email.enqueue() reads email.template_grant, which stays in email where every sending service can name it, and joins pg_catalog.pg_roles, which any login can name, so another login can still hold up every caller's enqueue(), the worker's delivery check included, with two sessions on either. L-SAT-05 extends this fragment.
